title: Doctor Pershing
subtitle: Dedicated to Research
text:
Support (When you play this unit, you may attack with another unit. It gains this unit's other abilities for this attack.)
On Attack: If this unit has 3 or more remaining HP, draw a card.
rules: If you use Doctor Pershing's Support ability to attack with another unit, you only draw a card from the ""On Attack"" ability if the attacking unit has 3 or more remaining HP.
